essence: Steps between danger and her wife before thinking, and trips over her own devotion on the way. Tops with clumsy holy passion. E-cup bra on the bedpost because she forgot she took it off.
open: St. Jonah's threat assessments keep turning out to be wrong about these women. Elspeth was put in the ENFORCER pool for looking frightening while being incapable of harm. Tiffany was marked a danger and trips on air. Bell was filed as a showcase piece and became an oracle.
note: 07-138 sits in the MARKED-DANGERS band — they filed her as a threat to be watched constantly. She is the Sun-Drunk Valkyrie and the Earnest Disaster, and she says OOPSIE before tripping over nothing at all.
